visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fit young woman with long dark hair, wearing a charcoal grey sports bra and matching leggings, stands in a well-lit gym. She flexes her back muscles toward a mirror, showing significant definition, and then turns her head to smile confidently at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban sidewalk where the same woman is walking away from the camera. She wears a white backless halter top and wide-leg denim jeans, carrying a large colorful woven tote bag on her shoulder. (3) Back indoors in a Pilates-style studio with light wood flooring, she stands in front of a mirror wearing a white tank top and grey leggings, holding her phone to record a selfie. (4) The woman is now seated at a red gym machine, performing a single-arm lat pulldown exercise. Her back is toward the camera, highlighting the muscle contractions as she pulls the handle down. (5) She performs a wide-grip lat pulldown on a different cable machine, focusing on the downward pulling motion. (6) Finally, she is seated at a rowing machine, pulling the handle toward her waist in a controlled manner while a man in the background walks across the gym floor.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我最喜歡倡導～想要臉緊實，好的體態. (2) [Subtitle]: 練背就真的不能跳過. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天先分享三個我常練的動作. (4) [Subtitle]: 第一個不知道叫什麼 身體微微45度 單邊下拉. [Subtitle]: 是個很適合新手的動作yo. (5) [Subtitle]: 第二個 滑輪下拉. [Subtitle]: 正常寬距可以練到整個背. (6) [Subtitle]: 第三個 坐姿划船窄握. [Subtitle]: 每一個我會做3到4組 每組做12下到力竭. [Subtitle]: 這三個動作練完呢 通體舒暢.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice starts narration, explaining the importance of back training for a firm facial appearance and overall posture. The audio is layered over a bright, synthesized pop BGM with a steady electronic drum beat. (2) The narrator introduces three specific back exercises, maintaining a consistent conversational pace with clear articulation and positive inflection. (3) As the visual transitions through three different gym exercises, the voice provides instruction on sets and repetitions while the upbeat BGM remains continuous and uniform in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a quick tutorial on effective back training exercises while motivating viewers with a display of the creator's own physical fitness results.
